Wilton's VIDEO_ID adapter probe (DCC and EGA tables identical to the book): near procs dispatched through a DGROUP table of (flag, near address) triples with lodsb/lodsw/call ax, carry-flag results (stc/jc), register arguments (DX port, AX device word), in/out/loop/loope/xlat/repne scasb, frameless far entries saving push si; push di (MSC 6.00/6.00A/6.00AX always push di first, probe ASM-2 in work/ovlA/probe), a code-segment string with a far pointer to it. MASM 5.10 /Mx reproduces all 472 bytes and the relocation. The 48-byte DGROUP table (35D2-3601) is referenced as extrn: the gate cannot bind near code offsets in a _DATA placement (full version work/misc/m39C7_S21_withdata.asm)
